personal_item_dimensions.notes: Official WestJet carry-on page, under-seat personal-item limit.

standard_carryon_dimensions.notes: Official WestJet carry-on page, overhead-bin bag limit.

standard_allowance.value: One carry-on bag and one personal item on Econo, Member Exclusive, EconoFlex, Premium, PremiumFlex, Business and BusinessFlex
standard_allowance.notes: Applies to WestJet and WestJet Encore operated flights.

ultrabasic_allowance.value: UltraBasic includes one personal item only, except specified Europe/Asia or Extended Comfort itineraries
ultrabasic_allowance.notes: The official page describes the route and purchased-seat exceptions.

standard_piece_weight.value: Under 50 lb (23 kg) per standard checked bag
standard_piece_weight.notes: Official WestJet baggage hub. Included pieces and prices depend on fare and itinerary.

purchase_timing.value: Prepay first or second checked bags online up to 24 hours before departure for the lowest price
purchase_timing.notes: WestJet states airport bag fees are higher.

checkin_opens.value: Check-in opens 24 hours before departure for most flights

domestic_cutoff.value: Domestic check-in closes 60 minutes before departure

international_cutoff.value: US and international check-in closes 60 minutes before departure
international_cutoff.notes: Official WestJet check-in page. Airport-specific exceptions may require more time.
